customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be the best in the market with excellent performance and installation. They appreciate its ease of use, with one customer noting the preset dispensing feature makes regular use smoother and more convenient. The water quality receives positive feedback, with one customer mentioning TDS levels below 100, and customers value the zero-service hassle for two years. However, reliability is a concern as some units stopped working within a month of use.

reviews.author: Yatendra Kumar
reviews.title: Nice product
reviews.body: The product was delivered on time, and the quality looks very good. Installation was fast and hassle-free. I am happy with the initial experience, and I hope the product will last long.

reviews.author: Lalit
reviews.title: Excellent Product with Great Performance and Premium Design!
reviews.body: I am extremely happy with my Native M2 Pro water purifier. The design is sleek and premium, the features are impressive, and the water dispensing is smooth and convenient. The purifier works well for everyday use and offers great value for money. The overall experience has been excellent, and I am very satisfied with my purchase. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a modern, feature-rich water purifier for their home!

reviews.author: JITENDER DHIMAN
reviews.title: Title: Fully satisfied
reviews.body: I am writing this review after using the Native M2 Pro RO for 3 months, and I am completely satisfied with its performance. The water tastes great. The best part is the zero-service hassle for 2 years. The touch dispensing and battery backup features work flawlessly. Go for it without any doubt!

reviews.author: Nayaz Mohammed
reviews.title: Good Purifier with Smart Features
reviews.body: I have been using the Native M2 Pro RO purifier and overall, I am quite satisfied with the product. The design is sleek, the water quality is good, and the purifier is easy to operate. The purification performance and taste of the water have been good so far. I also appreciate the smart features and overall user-friendly experience. One area where I feel there is scope for improvement is the after-sales service and clarity regarding filter replacement and maintenance costs.
